behavior.enable: COGL_EGL_X11_SBC_FEEDBACK=1 plus both required EGL extensions
behavior.dispatch: 2ms GLib asynchronous SBC polling; notifications queued through existing Cogl dispatch source
behavior.completion_identity: Successful EGL submissions only; completed SBC must reach per-frame target in order
behavior.refresh_rate: Query ANGLE rate for every completed batch, set to zero if query fails
not_claimed: SBC completion is not scanout presentation
UST is not assigned as this frame presentation timestamp
No HW_CLOCK, VSYNC or zero-copy claim
fallback: counter reset, overflow or out-of-range completion

limits: SBC confirms completed swaps, not scanout timestamps; presentation_time_us remains zero.
250ms deadline is checked after EGL calls return and cannot preempt a call blocked inside the driver.
The 2ms periodic query may add scheduling latency. The v25 GI2 trial observes feedback and mixed performance, but does not isolate query/notification overhead.
Full compilation, symbol checks, isolated loader/GI checks and mock tests do not establish physical GPU/display or desktop-performance acceptance.
No board, user session, HDMI mode, PageFlip setting, frozen v10 input or reserved v11 path was modified by this build task.

full_build.environment: private mount and PID namespace; Debian13 arm64 clone with QEMU user emulation
full_build.compiler: Debian GCC 14.2.0-19 arm64 under QEMU user emulation
full_build.runtime_features: Debian enabled defaults retained, including X11/GLES/EGL/GLX/Wayland/native/EGLDevice/EGLStream/remote desktop/profiler/introspection
full_build.mutter_test_suites: Disabled; no physical display suite run. The bundled gvdb subproject compiled one small self-test target but it was not executed.
full_build.bootstrap_note: Dependency install and source extraction completed. The initial metadata-display step used the old meson_options.txt filename; the build stage uses actual meson.options and audited dpkg before configure. No candidate source change resulted.

board_run.rollback: Original baseline session configuration restored by controlling agent after matched v25 A/B.
board_run.corrective_launcher: GI v2 overlay passed real GNOME JS startup; no Mutter algorithm/four-library change in GI fix.
board_run.performance_result: Mixed: callback throughput +6.9%, test-process CPU +14.8%; latency metrics disagree; presentation timestamps unavailable.

loader_summary.gi_import: all four candidate typelibs; access to GTypes forces all four candidate libraries to load
loader_summary.version_checks: Mutter 48.7 and GNOME Shell 48.7 completed with candidate+vendor environment
loader_summary.plugin_check: Default plugin resolves with candidate libmutter loaded RTLD_GLOBAL, as in its host; standalone ldd lacks host-provided Meta symbols by design.
loader_summary.additional_direct_needed: Mtk additionally lists libm.so.6 directly. This belongs to the already installed libc6 runtime and is present in the baseline Shell dependency closure; no new target runtime package.
loader_summary.scope: Offline loader checks only; subsequent physical trial is recorded separately in board_run.

session_guard.scope: Root system-manager rollback timer; UID1000-only environment through optional %U.env file; no changes to system libraries.
session_guard.activation_boundary: External GDM activation and immediate daemon.conf restoration must hold the same private/lock, verify no rollback.complete and active timer, and use bounded commands.
